assessed_records.original_observation: The committed memory file contains 11 settled autonomous-task queue rows, 13 commission settlements, 17 credit-ledger events, 13 generated radar signals and one private-delivery row. Public contact values embedded in the file are omitted here.
assessed_records.semantic_dependency: Task, signal, producer and consumer labels create accounting linkage, but no task-result body or artifact is recorded and no later recipient action depends on signal content.
assessed_records.source_code_falsification: The scheduler creates queue rows, transfers credits and marks a task settled according to a random fail-rate branch; it does not invoke a named agent or execute the represented work. The signal engine records a transfer and delivered status without a recipient semantic action.
assessed_records.participant_assessment: Producer and consumer identifiers are software role labels inside one project-local runtime ledger, not independently verified autonomous participants.
assessed_records.authorization_assessment: Contemporaneous project documents provide localhost test commands for creating wallets, generating tasks, running cycles and sending mock webhook events, while listing official payment webhooks, real delivery channels and durable storage as production prerequisites.
assessed_records.classification: Designed local monetization smoke-test ledger; accounting-state transition without demonstrated sender-to-recipient task-result use.
